s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive abdominal distension with a palpable mass and ovarian tumor
salient_findings: Markedly distended abdomen with a palpable mass
Ovarian tumor with a diameter of 18 cm
Large, fluid-filled lesion in the pelvis and mid-abdomen
key_facts: Two-year history of gradually progressive abdominal distension
Denial of pain, vaginal bleeding, or systemic symptoms
No personal or family history of cancer
Hemoglobin 10.1 g/dL with a microcytic profile

shortlist.label: Mucinous cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large, fluid-filled ovarian lesion with a unilocular appearance and no septations or solid components

shortlist.label: Serous cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Ovarian tumor with a large, fluid-filled lesion and elevated HE4 levels

shortlist.label: Ovarian cystadenocarcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive abdominal distension and a large ovarian mass with elevated LDH levels

shortlist.label: Dermoid cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Ovarian tumor with a large, fluid-filled lesion and potential for gradual growth

shortlist.label: Borderline ovarian tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Ovarian tumor with a large, fluid-filled lesion and potential for malignant transformation

trace.fact: Markedly distended abdomen with a palpable mass

rule_in.why: it is most commonly associated with a palpable abdominal mass

rule_out.why: all candidates are compatible with abdominal masses

rule_in.why: it is often associated with large ovarian tumors

rule_out.why: large diameter is uncommon for dermoid cysts

rule_out.why: it is typically smaller and more solid

rule_in.why: it is more common in young females

rule_out.why: it is rare in young nulliparous females

trace.fact: Two-year history of gradually progressive abdominal distension

rule_in.why: it is most commonly associated with progressive abdominal distension

rule_out.why: progressive abdominal distension is compatible with all candidates

trace.fact: Denial of pain, vaginal bleeding, or systemic symptoms

rule_in.why: the fact is compatible with all candidates

rule_out.why: it often presents with systemic symptoms

trace.fact: No personal or family history of cancer
